author: John Hammond
description:
A familiar browser prompt can be a pretty convincing disguise. ClickFix attacks use fake verification pages to manipulate people into running malicious commands themselves.

The interesting part is how an ordinary-looking interaction can turn into code execution on a local machine.

Full video: https://youtu.be/oJHOlNTH7lY?si=Oo1Cqr1PdgP4GhBc
title: The ClickFix Deception
